<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 480" width="600" height="480" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="480" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- title above the field -->
  <text x="320" y="95" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">uniform magnetic field into the page</text>
  <!-- region of uniform magnetic field, dashed -->
  <rect x="220" y="120" width="300" height="300" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
  <!-- crosses for the field into the page, kept clear of the path -->
  <g font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="340" y="160">×</text>
    <text x="390" y="160">×</text>
    <text x="440" y="160">×</text>
    <text x="490" y="160">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="210">×</text>
    <text x="390" y="210">×</text>
    <text x="440" y="210">×</text>
    <text x="490" y="210">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="260">×</text>
    <text x="390" y="260">×</text>
    <text x="440" y="260">×</text>
    <text x="490" y="260">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="310">×</text>
    <text x="390" y="310">×</text>
    <text x="440" y="310">×</text>
    <text x="490" y="310">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="360">×</text>
    <text x="390" y="360">×</text>
    <text x="440" y="360">×</text>
    <text x="490" y="360">×</text>
  </g>
  <!-- straight incoming part of the path, with arrow -->
  <line x1="60" y1="180" x2="220" y2="180" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="220,180 206,174 206,186" fill="#000000"/>
  <!-- semicircular path inside the field, centre on the left edge -->
  <path d="M 220 180 A 90 90 0 0 1 220 360" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- straight outgoing part of the path, with arrow -->
  <line x1="220" y1="360" x2="60" y2="360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="60,360 74,354 74,366" fill="#000000"/>
  <!-- centre of the semicircle and radius r -->
  <circle cx="220" cy="270" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="220" y1="270" x2="310" y2="270" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="265" y="262" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">r</text>
  <!-- labels for the electron and its speed -->
  <text x="140" y="170" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">speed <tspan font-style="italic">v</tspan></text>
  <text x="140" y="205" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">electron</text>
  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="320" y="460" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 3.1</text>
</svg>
